snippet.title: Zen Pinball FX - Official Showcase Trailer | THQ Nordic Digital Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Get a deep dive into what you can expect from Pinball FX, featuring more than 80 tables from various brands, including Marvel, Borderlands, Jurassic World, Williams Pinball, Zen originals, and more. Pinball FX is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox, Epic Games Store, Steam, and Nintendo Switch. 

The trailer also gives a look at the horror-inspired tables in Pinball FX: Midnight, featuring Chucky's Killer Pinball, The Thing pinball, and more. Pinball FX: Midnight is available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox, Epic Games Store, Steam, and Nintendo Switch. 

Finally, take a look at Pinball FX VR, featuring the ability to play in virtual reality and mixed reality. Pinball FX VR includes 3 tables and the ability to expand your library with tables like Indiana Jones, Star Trek: The Next Generation, and more. Pinball FX VR is available now.
